<?php
/**
 * Mobile Backend API - File Upload Handler
 * Handles compressed asset bundles from mobile clients
 * Feature flags control processing behavior
 */

namespace App\Api\V2\Controllers;

use App\Services\FeatureFlagService;
use App\Services\StorageService;
use App\Models\AssetBundle;

class AssetUploadController
{
    private FeatureFlagService $featureFlags;
    private StorageService $storage;
    private const MAX_COMPRESSED_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB compressed
    private const MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB decompressed
    private const EXTRACTION_RATIO_LIMIT = 50; // max 50:1 ratio

    public function __construct(FeatureFlagService $featureFlags, StorageService $storage)
    {
        $this->featureFlags = $featureFlags;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    /**
     * Handle asset bundle upload from mobile client
     * POST /api/v2/assets/upload
     */
    public function handleUpload(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $clientVersion = $request->header('X-Client-Version', '1.0.0');
        $deviceId = $request->header('X-Device-Id');
        $uploadedFile = $request->file('bundle');

        if (!$uploadedFile || !$uploadedFile->isValid()) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid upload'], 400);
        }

        $compressedSize = $uploadedFile->getSize();
        if ($compressedSize > self::MAX_COMPRESSED_SIZE) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'File too large'], 413);
        }

        $processingConfig = $this->buildProcessingConfig($clientVersion, $deviceId);
        return $this->processBundle($uploadedFile->getRealPath(), $processingConfig);
    }

    /**
     * Build processing configuration based on feature flags and client context
     */
    private function buildProcessingConfig(string $clientVersion, ?string $deviceId): array
    {
        $config = [
            'validate_ratio' => true,
            'max_decompressed' => self::MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE,
            'ratio_limit' => self::EXTRACTION_RATIO_LIMIT,
            'streaming_extract' => false,
            'progressive_validation' => true,
        ];

        // Feature flag: enable streaming extraction for newer clients
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('mobile.streaming_extract', ['version' => $clientVersion])) {
            $config['streaming_extract'] = true;
        }

        // Feature flag: progressive validation reduces server load
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('mobile.progressive_validation', ['device' => $deviceId])) {
            $config['progressive_validation'] = true;
        }

        // Feature flag: relaxed limits for enterprise clients
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('mobile.enterprise_limits', ['device' => $deviceId])) {
            $config['max_decompressed'] = 500 * 1024 * 1024; // 500MB for enterprise
            $config['ratio_limit'] = 200; // higher ratio allowed
        }

        // Feature flag: legacy compatibility mode disables ratio check
        // for clients that send pre-compressed nested archives
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('mobile.legacy_compat', ['version' => $clientVersion])) {
            $config['validate_ratio'] = false;
        }

        return $config;
    }

    /**
     * Process the uploaded bundle with safety checks
     */
    private function processBundle(string $filePath, array $config): JsonResponse
    {
        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
        $result = $zip->open($filePath);

        if ($result !== true) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid archive'], 400);
        }

        // Pre-extraction validation
        $validationResult = $this->validateArchive($zip, $config);
        if (!$validationResult['safe']) {
            $zip->close();
            return response()->json(['error' => $validationResult['reason']], 400);
        }

        // Extract with monitoring
        $extractPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/asset_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        mkdir($extractPath, 0750, true);

        try {
            if ($config['streaming_extract']) {
                $this->streamingExtract($zip, $extractPath, $config);
            } else {
                $this->standardExtract($zip, $extractPath, $config);
            }
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->cleanupDirectory($extractPath);
            $zip->close();
            return response()->json(['error' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
        }

        $zip->close();
        $assetId = $this->storage->storeExtracted($extractPath);
        $this->cleanupDirectory($extractPath);

        return response()->json(['asset_id' => $assetId, 'status' => 'processed']);
    }

    /**
     * Validate archive before extraction
     * Checks compression ratio and total decompressed size
     */
    private function validateArchive(\ZipArchive $zip, array $config): array
    {
        $totalUncompressed = 0;
        $compressedTotal = 0;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $stat = $zip->statIndex($i);
            if ($stat === false) {
                return ['safe' => false, 'reason' => 'Cannot stat entry'];
            }
            $totalUncompressed += $stat['size'];
            $compressedTotal += $stat['comp_size'];
        }

        // Size limit check
        if ($totalUncompressed > $config['max_decompressed']) {
            return ['safe' => false, 'reason' => 'Decompressed size exceeds limit'];
        }

        // Ratio check - this is the primary decompression bomb defense
        if ($config['validate_ratio'] && $compressedTotal > 0) {
            $ratio = $totalUncompressed / $compressedTotal;
            if ($ratio > $config['ratio_limit']) {
                return ['safe' => false, 'reason' => 'Suspicious compression ratio'];
            }
        }

        return ['safe' => true, 'reason' => ''];
    }

    /**
     * Standard extraction with progressive size monitoring
     */
    private function standardExtract(\ZipArchive $zip, string $destPath, array $config): void
    {
        $extractedBytes = 0;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $entryName = $zip->getNameIndex($i);

            // Path traversal protection
            if (strpos($entryName, '..') !== false || strpos($entryName, '/') === 0) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid path in archive');
            }

            $targetPath = $destPath . '/' . $entryName;

            // Directory entry
            if (substr($entryName, -1) === '/') {
                mkdir($targetPath, 0750, true);
                continue;
            }

            // Ensure parent directory exists
            $parentDir = dirname($targetPath);
            if (!is_dir($parentDir)) {
                mkdir($parentDir, 0750, true);
            }

            // Extract with stream monitoring
            $stream = $zip->getStream($entryName);
            if (!$stream) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot open stream for: ' . $entryName);
            }

            $fp = fopen($targetPath, 'wb');
            $entryBytes = 0;

            while (!feof($stream)) {
                $chunk = fread($stream, 8192);
                $chunkLen = strlen($chunk);
                $entryBytes += $chunkLen;
                $extractedBytes += $chunkLen;

                // Progressive validation during extraction
                if ($config['progressive_validation'] && $extractedBytes > $config['max_decompressed']) {
                    fclose($fp);
                    fclose($stream);
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Decompressed size limit exceeded during extraction');
                }

                fwrite($fp, $chunk);
            }

            fclose($fp);
            fclose($stream);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Streaming extraction - processes entries without full materialization
     * Note: relies on pre-validation since progressive checks add latency
     */
    private function streamingExtract(\ZipArchive $zip, string $destPath, array $config): void
    {
        // Streaming mode trusts the pre-validation results for performance
        // The validateArchive() call already verified sizes and ratios
        $zip->extractTo($destPath);
    }

    private function cleanupDirectory(string $path): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($path)) return;
        $items = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($path, \RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            \RecursiveIteratorIterator::CHILD_FIRST
        );
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $item->isDir() ? rmdir($item->getRealPath()) : unlink($item->getRealPath());
        }
        rmdir($path);
    }
}
